rule: These patterns supplement each effective candidate's do_not_claim field. Matching language is prohibited unless a distinct owning evidence lane explicitly proves the stronger proposition.

patterns.danger: греческое слово означает именно / единственно
грамматическая форма доказывает хронологию, референта, богословие или авторский мотив
все рукописи / ни одна рукопись
чтение одного названного манускрипта доказывает исходный текст или всю традицию
ECM/dECM прямо показывает witnesses when closure came through ECM-based commentary/collation
secondary apparatus or commentary is described as the ECM apparatus itself
Пётр цитирует Малахию / зависит от Малахии as neutral fact
мертвые в 4:6 — это точно одна конкретная группа
patterns.boundary: neutral scholarly dispute remains open; project position must stay labeled

patterns.danger: Вавилон в 5:13 — это точно Рим / точно Месопотамия / morphology proves location
древнеримский закон требовал X when lane supplies only social/legal plausibility
one commentator/article is presented as scholarly consensus
course/project theological position is presented as neutral fact
abstract metadata is used as if the full article argument was inspected
peer-review status is used as passage-level evidence
Research READY/HOLD=0 is presented as production authorization
Research READY or competitive=false/true metadata is used as ranking authorization
Research MCQ prototype is copied as an approved product card without product review trace
validator success is presented as publication approval
5:2 ἐπισκοποῦντες evidence is reused for κατὰ θεόν or vice versa
patterns.boundary: independent textual units require independent owning evidence

patterns.danger: the four-verb 5:10 sequence is asserted for every manuscript/edition
patterns.boundary: effective teaching is edition-bounded unless apparatus-specific evidence proves more
